whenToUse: Rows of non-tabular lists: recent posts, contacts in a side panel, notifications, search results.
Leading visual, title, description, meta and actions in one row.
avoidWhen: Columned data with sorting — use Data Table or Table.
A record's full identity card — use Entity card.
a11y: ItemList renders a list; a clickable row uses one link, actions stay separate.
Hover-revealed actions are also visible on focus.
